description: The epic's first constitutional act: publish exactly the wave-1 rows of the frozen ledger, using T-378's commands, against the LIVE registry. PR-032's ratio is the standing record of what that combination produced: 'duplicate publications of the Westphalia KPI doctrine already published as PR-029 ... minted minutes apart by the same agent on the same task through retry inadvertence'. A re-run is not a repair; it is a second record. Batch your commands, and after EVERY batch run the census check before doing anything else.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY the new PR-NNN.json files it mints under .harness/precedents/. MUST NOT edit any existing record, .harness/bin/precedent.py, PRECEDENT.md, INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md, .harness/precedents/README.md, ORCHESTRATION.md, .harness/state.json, claude.md, gemini.md or any test file. Acquire the write lock before the first publish: python3 .harness/bin/lock.py acquire .harness/precedents --holder <you> --task T-379, and release it at the end.

NEVER HAND-WRITE A RECORD. Every record is minted by running the real CLI. A hand-created or hand-edited JSON file under .harness/precedents/ is an automatic REJECT: the whole point is that the layer amends itself through its own protocol.

PUBLISH EXACTLY THE LEDGER'S WAVE-1 ROWS, in ledger order, using T-378's quoted commands verbatim. A row you cannot publish as quoted is a BLOCKED handoff naming the row and the exact refusal message - never a ratio re-drafted at the keyboard. A row you skip silently is a defect the census will catch anyway.

CENSUS CHECK AFTER EVERY BATCH, these exact commands: python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py list --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(len(r)); print(','.join(x['id'] for x in r))"   and   ls .harness/precedents/PR-*.json | wc -l. The count must equal 34 + (rows published so far). PUBLISH-RETRY PROHIBITION, quoted into your handoff: if any publish's exit code was not observed, or the count is not what the ledger predicts, STOP - run the census check FIRST and compare against the frozen ledger before touching anything. Never re-run a publish command to 'make sure'. If the census disagrees with the ledger, hand off blocked; a duplicate cannot be deleted (records are immutable, .harness/precedents is in state.json protected_paths, and voiding one is a tier-1 act).

NO SELF-CONFIRMATION: every record publishes with confirmation_status unconfirmed and confirmed_by null (SDR-02, PR-015). You are the producer; a producer-confirmed record is an automatic REJECT.
